traits.smithy.api#documentation:
AWS Billing and Cost Management Data Hub lets you query your AWS cost and usage data with SQL.
Create datasets over your billing data, then start, monitor, and retrieve the results of query
executions against them.
traits.smithy.api#title: AWS Billing and Cost Management Data Hub

Region.documentation: The AWS region used to dispatch the request.

UseDualStack.documentation: When true, use the dual-stack endpoint. If the configured endpoint does not support dual-stack, dispatching the request MAY return an error.

UseFIPS.documentation: When true, send this request to the FIPS-compliant regional endpoint. If the configured endpoint does not have a FIPS compliant endpoint, dispatching the request will return an error.

Endpoint.documentation: Override the endpoint used to send this request

`arn:<partition>:bcm-data-hub:<region>:<accountId>:dataset/<datasetId>`
The trailing segment is the DatasetId (schema name + base-36 UUID).

The immutable, service-generated identifier of a dataset: the schema name
(up to 38 characters) and a base-36-encoded UUID (25 characters) joined by a
hyphen. Returned on the read views and embedded in the ARN.

A reference to a dataset in any of its three forms:
  - name: `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]*`                            (see DatasetName)
  - id:   `[a-z_]{1,38}-[0-9a-z]{25}`                     (see DatasetId)
  - arn:  `arn:aws[a-z-]*:bcm-data-hub:...:dataset/<id>`  (see DatasetArn)

Caller-supplied name for a dataset; also the SQL table name. Mutable and
unique per account. Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only (like
Redshift/Glue identifiers).
